title: Time-series forecasting for demand, capacity, and budget planning
primary_chapter_title: Human–AI Decision Systems and Managerial Action
purpose: Fits simple trend and exponential-smoothing forecasts to operational or financial time series and compares forecast accuracy.
input: `TimeSeries` sheet with date and value; `Parameters` sheet with forecast horizon and seasonal period.
outputs: Forecast table, fitted values, holdout error metrics, forecast chart, uncertainty band, and planning summary.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
